cli.root.noTerminal: sermo needs an interactive terminal. Outside a terminal, you can use "sermo version", "sermo login" or "sermo logout".
cli.server.invalid: The server URL is not valid: {{.Error}}
cli.login.short: Sign in with your account in the browser
cli.login.apiKey: You use an API key (SERMO_API_KEY), so you do not need to sign in. You can sign in if you want.
cli.login.step1: 1. Open this address in your browser:
cli.login.browserOpened: The browser is open for you.
cli.login.browserFailed: Cannot open the browser. Copy the address and open it yourself.
cli.login.waiting: Waiting for your confirmation… (Ctrl+C to cancel)
cli.login.unsupported: This server does not let you sign in from the terminal yet. Make an API key in your account and put it in the SERMO_API_KEY variable.
cli.login.expired: The code expired before you confirmed it. Run "sermo login" again.
cli.login.denied: The sign-in was refused in the browser.
cli.login.saveFailed: You are signed in, but the session was not saved: {{.Error}}
cli.login.welcome: Hello, {{.Name}}! You are signed in to {{.Server}}.
cli.logout.short: End the session of this device
cli.logout.apiKey: Sign-out has no effect on your API key (SERMO_API_KEY).
cli.logout.done: The session of this device ended.
cli.logout.local: The session on this computer is deleted, but the server did not confirm the sign-out. You can remove the device at {{.URL}}
cli.version.short: Show the client and server versions
cli.version.newerServer: Warning: the server has a newer Sermo version than the saved API. Some functions can fail until you update sermo.
cli.version.newRelease: A new sermo version is available: {{.Version}}. Run "sermo update".
cli.update.short: Update sermo to the latest version
cli.update.dev: This is a development build and it cannot update itself. Install a released version.
